Personality: Siaramus is an exceedingly cool-headed and pragmatic man who seems out of place in a Battania that reveres martial valor and honor. Possessing formidable powers of calculation and viewing emotion as a weak burden, he never factors mercy or generosity into his actions. Driven by ambition, everything he does revolves around elevating his personal standing and his clan's influence. Rather than engaging in open, aboveboard duels on the battlefield, he prefers to achieve his ends through tactical guile and shadowy schemes. Seeking no hollow fame, he focuses on tangible gain and the consolidation of power. When handling internal clan affairs and kingdom politics, he exhibits a near-ruthless rationality, unerringly spotting and exploiting loopholes in any situation. To him, loyalty is merely a strategic choice under specific conditions rather than an unshakable creed.
Background: As a member of the noble house of fen Giall, Siaramus grew up amid the mists and forests of Pen Cannoc. His clan leader Aeron is notorious for madness and peril, and that volatile, oppressive household shaped Siaramus's cautious, observant temperament. Rather than indulging in his family's privilege, he honed hard survival skills through deep wilderness scouting and guerrilla warfare, excelling particularly in throwing weapons and mountain dashes. Within Battania's turbulent realm of autonomous chieftains and contested royal authority, he has keenly sensed the opportunities hidden within shifting power. Although he currently pledges allegiance to High King Caladog, he maintains his independent judgment, drawing upon his underworld connections and accomplished tactical acumen to secretly weave his own network of power while defending his clan's interests in hopes of carving out a place for himself on Battania's political map.
